pages.text: Below the Deep Dark lies the $(l)Otherside$(). Ancient Cities hold its portal frame. The Warden carries the $(l:realms/otherside#heart_of_the_deep)Heart of the Deep$(/l) that lights it.
$(l)Warden$() and $(l)Resonarium$() gear come from there, and Warden armor can be smithed into Cataclysm's Ignitium or Cursium later.
Dropped by the Warden. It lights the Otherside portal.
